verdict.rationale: Built-in site performance and visitor analytics is a fair question for a hosting platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any built-in analytics, metrics dashboards, or visitor-behavior tracking. The only related item is a user running Uptime Kuma on Fly, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics
